title: QA↔PO-001: Release-Readiness Assessment + Quality-Gate Status
description: QA provides quality and release-readiness status, coverage/defect reporting, and a sign-off recommendation; Product Owner/TPM provides acceptance criteria, prioritization, and the release gates/criteria. Grounded in QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.10. The QA go/no-go is a permanent HITL gate: a NO-GO halts the lifecycle and is not autonomously overridable.

open_critical_fmea_chains.description: Open Critical FMEA chains (RPN ≥ 200) with no mitigation — must be 0 to ship (Prime Directive §10.1).

x-macp.tier_rationale: QA owns the go/no-go gate (permanent HITL). A QA NO_GO halts the lifecycle for the affected component and is not overridable by PO; the binding release decision is ratified by humans.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CONTINUOUS (acceptance-criteria intake; milestone quality reviews; mandatory sign-off checkpoint before any go/no-go release decision)
confirm_conditions: release_readiness carries a go_no_go_recommendation and open_defects counts
coverage_pct reported honestly with its % unit
open_critical_fmea_chains = 0 and open critical defects = 0 for a GO
reject_conditions: a GO recommended with open Critical FMEA chains (RPN ≥ 200) or open CRITICAL defects (violates Prime Directive §10.1)
PO overriding a QA NO_GO without QA clearance (bypasses the go/no-go gate — forbidden)
coverage or defect counts softened/rounded to clear a gate (Honesty Over Polish, §10.3)
counter_conditions: acceptance criteria untestable as written — request measurable criteria before the readiness assessment
release gate definition incomplete — request the full gate list before sign-off
